version: ASTRA MEDICAL CLAIM AUDIT Ω v0.4

source.dataset: SciFact official 2020, development 300 claims, corpus 5183 abstracts
source.data_license: SciFact CC BY-NC 2.0; no commercial use

method.retriever: ASTRA BM25 from source-only claim text, lower-case tokenization title+abstract, k1=1.2, b=0.75
method.recall_definition: At least one annotated relevant document among top k, denominator=188 labeled claims, not all 300

limitations: Document discovery is not fact verification
On the 112 NEI claims there are no positive documents in SciFact gold, so ranking precision is not evaluable from these labels
Metrics do not provide medical false-positive or false-negative rates
No independence from originating SciFact dataset, but retrieval is free of oracle hints
